Sam Patel: Quick FYI — AcmeBank legal asked for a SOC 2 Type II summary + a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also want to know if Dedicated POC with customer KMS separation changes pricing, and how we want them to upload evidence (SFTP vs presigned URL). POC window is ~2 weeks. Can security/eng/finance advise? @Taylor @Liam @Nina
Taylor Nguyen: We can provide the SOC2 summary (redacted) and a pen-test attestation letter. For signature we need the customer's legal entity name + sig contact and whether they need notarized wording. Also: do they want the full red-team report or just a signed scope/attestation?
Sam Patel: They said "signed letter + high-level scope" only — not the full report.
Liam O'Connor: Presigned S3 URLs are simplest for uploads. We'll generate time-limited PUT URLs and enforce size limits. If they insist on SFTP we can provision an ephemeral box but that slows turnaround. Example (redacted):
```
aws s3 cp evidence.zip "https://redwood-presigned.example/?X-Amz-Algorithm=..." --acl private
```
Taylor Nguyen: Note about KMS: true tenant key separation (customer-managed KMS) is only available on Private deployments. For Dedicated we can do per-tenant key scoping/integration but it requires extra setup and will impact pricing. @Nina can you confirm the pricing delta for a Dedicated POC with managed KMS?
Nina (Finance): Short answer: yes, there's a delta. Rough estimate for Dedicated POC — one-time setup fee + ~20% uplift on committed monthly for KMS separation + potential HSM costs if requested. I can produce a firm quote by EOD once Sam confirms expected throughput.
Jessica (Sales Ops): Action items: 1) Sam to confirm customer legal name & signature contact. 2) Taylor to prepare SOC2 summary + pen-test attestation draft. 3) Liam to provide presigned upload flow, size limits, and validation checklist. 4) Nina to send pricing delta/quote.
Sam Patel: I'll get legal contact from the morning call and confirm throughput. Also, can we meet the customer's ask of artifacts within 48 hours after they sign?
Taylor Nguyen: Yes — once we have signed permission from the customer we can produce the attestation draft and SOC2 summary within 48 hours. Notarized signature may add 1 business day.
Maria (Legal): Recommend this wording for the attestation: "This attestation is limited to the scope of the third-party penetration test conducted and is not an exhaustive security guarantee. Redwood Inference attests the test was coordinated per mutually agreed scope and dates." I can review the final draft.
Liam O'Connor: Operational notes for upload: max single file 5GB, multipart allowed, presigned URLs valid for 72 hours by default. We'll run a quick integrity check on receipt (sha256). If they prefer SFTP we need 24–48 hrs to provision and rotate creds.
Sam Patel: Great. Also asked whether any artifact redaction is required — answer: we provide redacted SOC2 summary and a high-level scope page from the pen-test vendor. No raw logs.
audit-bot: Evidence package queued: evidence_acmebank_337654.zip (size 42MB). Uploaded to staging by Sam at 2025-03-10T16:12:05Z
Sam Patel: Ping @Taylor @Maria — package is uploaded to staging. Can you review and wrap the attestation?
Taylor Nguyen: Reviewing now. I'll post the draft in this thread when ready (ETA: tomorrow AM).
Maria (Legal): I'll review the draft after Taylor posts, will add one minor clause about liability limits.
Jessica (Sales Ops): I've added the POC checklist and provisional pricing delta to the tracker. Sam — once Taylor/Maria approve, please send the signed attestation to customer and update SLA fields. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: Thanks team — assigning this to Taylor/Maria for doc finalization and Nina for final quote. I'll update the customer after we confirm wording.
